card.name: Partway through split words and names
card.fires_on: A piece in the middle of a longer word or name that is broken up, often letter-spaced headings or rare proper names. Examples are the 'u' in D-u-oden-al, 'and' in archimandrite, and 'BE' in BEHAVIORAL.

modes.label: Spaced-out headings
modes.description: Single letters or short pieces inside headings written with spaces between letters or split oddly.

modes.label: Rare names and long words
modes.description: An inner piece of an uncommon name, publisher or long word that is split into several parts.

modes.label: Capitalized heading words
modes.description: A piece starting a word after AND in all-caps headings.
